quotes.quote: Cade has found a groove ever since we got on his ass. He must be a fan of the show because we got on his ass, didn't understand what was going on. We got on Trae Young's ass too, but he did not write the ship. We will get to that in a second.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert

quotes.excerpt: The Cavs have made a conscious effort to tell James Harden to score the ball.
quotes.quote: The Cavs have made a conscious effort to tell James Harden to score the ball. I'm going to take the Cavs in this. text_blocks.text: It's about time to get up off of Jamal Murray. It's about time, or you going to have to get rid of Jokic.
